summary: Backend testing complete - All 24 tests passed. Comprehensive testing of authentication, user management, club config, match CRUD, voting, lineup generation, result recording with stat tracking, and permission controls.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ All MongoDB _id properly excluded from responses
✅ JWT Bearer token authentication correctly implemented
✅ Rating calculation formula correct: goals*3 + assists*2 + matches_played
✅ Vote overwriting works correctly (single vote per user per match)
✅ Lineup generation uses snake draft by rating
✅ Result editing properly reverts prior stats before applying new
✅ Match deletion reverts all stat contributions
✅ Permission checks working: admin, editor (can_edit_matches), and regular user roles
✅ Config GET is public (no auth required), PUT is admin-only
✅ All endpoints return proper HTTP status codes (200, 400, 401, 403, 404)
seed_data_creation: Tests create unique users per test run using timestamp-based email addresses (TEST_*_{timestamp}@clubdodo.com). Admin user (admin@clubdodo.com / dodo2026) is seeded on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints tested and working correctly. JWT Bearer tokens used (NOT cookies). Rating formula verified: goals*3 + assists*2 + matches_played. Snake draft lineup generation working. Stat tracking with proper reversion on edit/delete. Permission system (admin/editor/user) functioning correctly. No MongoDB _id exposure. Team size validation: min 3, max 11.

auth: POST /api/auth/login - admin login returns admin role
GET /api/auth/me - with Bearer token returns user
users: GET /api/users - lists users sorted by rating desc
config: PUT /api/config - admin only, updates club_name and club_logo
matches: POST /api/matches - any authenticated user can create
GET /api/matches/{id} - returns match with votes array
POST /api/matches/{id}/generate-lineup - editor only, snake draft by rating
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - editor only, updates stats and rating

verified_requirements: ✅ POST /api/auth/login with admin returns admin role
✅ GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns user
✅ GET /api/users lists users sorted by rating desc
✅ GET /api/config returns club_name/club_logo (public, no auth required)
✅ PUT /api/config (admin only) updates club_name and club_logo
✅ GET /api/matches/{id} returns match with votes array containing {user_id, name, shirt_number, rating, vote}
✅ POST /api/matches/{id}/vote stores vote (yes/no/reserve), overwrites previous vote
✅ POST /api/matches/{id}/generate-lineup (editor only) splits yes voters using snake draft by rating
✅ POST /api/matches/{id}/result records goals/assists, increments matches_played, updates user stats
✅ DELETE /api/matches/{id} (editor only) removes match and reverts stat contributions
✅ Player rating = goals*3 + assists*2 + matches_played (verified after recording result)
✅ Non-admin user cannot grant edit access (403)
✅ User without can_edit_matches & not admin cannot generate lineup or record result (403)
✅ No MongoDB _id exposure in any response
